password_hash.description: The HASH of a protection password, never the password. Protection of this kind is a convenience against accidents, not security: the content is not encrypted.

Legacy.description: The 16-bit spreadsheet legacy password hash (ECMA-376 Part 4, 14.7.1).

Iterated.description: A salted, iterated hash (ECMA-376 Part 1, 18.2.29): H0 = hash(salt bytes followed by the password as UTF-16LE); then spin_count times Hn = hash(Hn-1 followed by the 4-byte little-endian iteration counter n-1).

algorithm.description: Hash algorithm name as stored: `SHA-512`, `SHA-384` or `SHA-256`. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

hash.description: The final hash, standard base64 with padding. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

salt.description: The salt, standard base64 with padding. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

spin_count.description: Number of iterations, 0..4294967295 (the usual value is 100000).

description: The structure node of a spreadsheet/1 document (node type core.sheet.workbook, node_id `workbook`): the ORDER of the sheets and the workbook-wide settings. It holds no sheet content - each sheet is a node of its own, named here by node_id.

active_sheet.description: node_id of the sheet that is shown when the workbook opens. Absent when `active_sheet_index` names no sheet.

active_sheet_index.description: Zero-based position in `sheets` of the sheet shown when the workbook opens. `active_sheet`, when present, names the same sheet by identity and wins if the two disagree.

iterative.description: Circular references are evaluated repeatedly instead of being an error.

max_change.description: Iteration stops when no value changes by more than this.

mode.description: When formulas are recalculated. Automatic: after every change. AutomaticExceptTables: likewise, except data tables. Manual: only on request - the cached results in the computed nodes may then be older than the cells.

precision_as_displayed.description: Numbers are rounded to their displayed precision when stored.

csv_delimiter.description: The field separator, as a byte value (59 = `;`, 9 = tab), of the CSV file this workbook was read from; a CSV export writes the same one. Absent when the workbook did not come from CSV.

custom_lists.description: Custom fill series (e.g. a list of branch names) beyond the built-in ones.

items.description: One entry. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

date_system.description: How a NUMBER in a cell maps to a calendar date when its number format is a date format. The number is a count of days (the fraction is the time of day: 0.5 = 12:00). `D1900`: day 1 is 1900-01-01, and day 60 is the NON-EXISTENT 1900-02-29 (a historical bug kept for compatibility), so day 61 is 1900-03-01 and, for every day number n >= 61, date = 1899-12-30 + n days. `D1904`: day 0 is 1904-01-01, date = 1904-01-01 + n days, no fictitious day. The manifest's `conventions` state the same numbers.

external_values.description: node_id of the core.sheet.external-values node: the cached values of cells of OTHER workbooks that formulas refer to. Absent when there are none.

names.description: node_id of the core.sheet.names node: the defined names.

ooxml.description: node_id of the x.gridcraft.ooxml node carrying workbook-level content of an imported OOXML file that GridCraft keeps without modelling it. Absent when there is none.

author.description: Author. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

company.description: Company. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

description.description: Comments. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

keywords.description: Keywords. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

subject.description: Subject. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

title.description: Title. Free text: content, never a reference - a reader shows or stores it and never resolves it as a path or address.

protected_structure.description: The workbook structure is protected: sheets cannot be added, removed, renamed, moved or unhidden.

schema_version.description: Revision of this payload's schema. Always 1 in profile spreadsheet/1.

sheets.description: The sheets in tab order, first tab first. Each entry is the node_id of a core.sheet.sheet node.

structure_password.description: Hash of the password of the structure protection. Absent when there is none.

styles.description: node_id of the core.sheet.styles node: the cell formats the cells' style ids index, the named styles and the theme.

vba.description: node_id of the node carrying a VBA macro project verbatim: a core.sheet.vba-project node (the project is a compound file, format `ovba`), or an x.gridcraft.vba node (bytes in no defined format). Absent when the workbook has no macros. The project is embedded CODE and is never executed automatically.

title: core.sheet.workbook - the structure node of a spreadsheet/1 document
